text: Tree arrived with disease and poor quality roots. Very expensive for what we received. Took weeks to get a response about replacement. Disappointed with the service.
author: James Peterson

text: Beautiful Japanese maple arrived in perfect condition. The colour is absolutely stunning in autumn, and it's become the focal point of our garden. Highly recommended!
author: Sarah Thompson

text: Excellent service from start to finish. The cherry tree is thriving and the spring blossom display was absolutely gorgeous. Would definitely order from Papervale again.
author: Michael Chen

text: Great quality tree and very healthy. The silver bark is striking in winter. Planting instructions were clear and helpful. Only minor issue with delivery timing but easily resolved.
author: Emma Watson

text: Planted this in our orchard a year ago and it's already producing fruit. The team at Papervale provided great advice on aftercare. Fantastic service!
author: David Morrison
